name: Habitline
summary: Consumer habit-tracker app launch page: a burnt-orange motion-blur portrait hero with a dark phone UI and floating glass widgets, then a pale grey page with soft cloud imagery, phone mockups, marquee tiles and huge orange stat numerals.

fonts.pairing: Stack Sans Headline 500 at 1.0 leading for every heading (68 H1, 48 H2, 90 display, 120 and 220 numerals); Google Sans Flex 500 for body, lead and nav

signature: hero photo of a person in heavy orange motion blur, with a dark phone UI rising out of a white cloud fade at the bottom
inline emoji-style image pills set inside the line of a large statement headline
phone mockup centred over two marquee rows of habit tiles and lifestyle photos that run behind it
giant orange stat numeral with a soft orange glow and a tilted white sticker label slapped across it
soft photographic clouds used as section transitions and to swallow the bottom of phones
imagery: warm cinematic lifestyle photography with motion blur, polished dark and light app screens in phone frames, small habit icons in coloured circles, photographic clouds, a hand holding a phone in the CTA
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, about 25-30px outer gutter, 200px section top padding, 2-column feature cards with 20px radii, 3-up stats, centered statement blocks
